title: Impulse and Change in Momentum
body: A hockey player hits a stationary ball of mass 150 g with a force that acts for 0.02 s. The ball leaves the hockey stick at a velocity of 20 m/s. Calculate: (a) the impulse delivered to the ball, and (b) the average force exerted by the hockey stick on the ball.
oer: Siyavula Physical Sciences Grade 12 - Momentum and Impulse
